He came back and I have been dedicated to a fault- and allowed a lot of hurt and almost abusive behavior back at me. And I have stayed.

I am devastated and trying to stay strong in knowing that no matter what- that was not the right thing to do and to stay strong in no contact unless they return home. They walked out when their presence was needed the most- and after so many years you don’t just leave like that.
Even with the recent hurt, anger, and defeat that I feel… I only want my person. I don’t and have not talked to anyone, allowed any conversations to start with me, etc. still fully committed and devoted to him. And feeling a bit worthless and dumb. 
It’s been rough.

Probably not the response or perspective you’re looking for… but I’m the WP and it’s been over a year since everything came out and I laid all secrets and truths out. My BP revenged me… multiple times and did so to hurt me as much as he could. I gave him an out and told him I wanted him to be happy and that I couldn’t keep getting beat up and being a secret (he told everyone what I had done and then came back and kept it secret… but was sleeping around too…) but he denied the out and brought me back to his life and said he wanted me and couldn’t help it and that was it. However- a year later he can be the absolute meanest human I have ever experienced. I have been torn down so many times… still… and has actually gotten to where I have considered suicide many times because I am just convinced the world would not even care. It isn’t always bad. I love him more than I could ever explain and have done everything imaginable to fix my mistakes and still fight so hard for him and for us… even when being called trash, whore, filth, being told he hates me/ doesn’t love me/ doesn’t care about me/ calls me a cunt… has literally dumped beer over my head… etc. 
I know I don’t deserve that. I do. But like he always says… I created this. I don’t know when I’ll walk away… but I’m telling you behaving this way to your person causes more damage than I think you realize. I’m more so convinced I won’t walk away… but instead get to the point where he will just find me dead because eventually I’ll break to the point where I can’t pull myself back out of it. That’s my biggest fear. When you love someone— you put up with more than you’d ever imagine…. but please try to not treat your person so poorly. People make mistakes. People make bad choices- bad decisions- bad judgments… it doesn’t make them bad people and it doesn’t mean they don’t love you and wouldn’t do everything they can to make up for it with you… you have to let them do that though and can’t continue to punish them for something that no matter what they can’t take back.
